name: Oil & Gas E&P Multi-Factor SIF Screening Profile
description: Configurable heuristic screening profile for detecting Serious Injury & Fatality precursors in E&P operations.
threshold_semantics: CONFIGURABLE HEURISTIC SCREENING THRESHOLDS. These values (potential_sif_min_score=0.45, non_sif_max_score=0.20) are configurable operational screening heuristics, not validated statistical probabilities, certified SIF determinations, official OIL SIF thresholds, or universal industry standards. Future calibration requires labelled OIL evaluation data.

factor_descriptions.energy_hazard: High or stored energy hazard presence (weight: 0.35)
factor_descriptions.exposure_proximity: Personnel exposure, line of fire, or proximity (weight: 0.30)
factor_descriptions.barrier_degradation: Degraded, bypassed, or absent safety barrier (weight: 0.25)
factor_descriptions.context: Qualitative operational context (activity, equipment). Does not directly contribute to numeric score in SIF_SCREENING_PROFILE_V1 (weight: 0.00)

screening_rules.name: Suspended Dynamic Load with Worker Exposure & Rigging Failure
screening_rules.description: High-energy suspended load coupled with personnel in line of fire/swing path and rigging/line failure.
screening_rules.severity_details: Catastrophic crush fatality or severe blunt impact under swinging/falling heavy load.

screening_rules.name: High Pressure Hydrocarbon Release with Isolation Failure
screening_rules.description: High pressure fluid/gas hazard with compromised double-block-and-bleed or live line unbolting.
screening_rules.severity_details: Uncontrolled pressurized hydrocarbon gas release, high-velocity projectile impact, or vapor cloud ignition.

screening_rules.name: Working at Height with Disconnected Fall Protection
screening_rules.description: Elevated fall hazard (derrick/mast/scaffold) with unhooked harness, missing tie-off, or compromised guardrail.
screening_rules.severity_details: Fatal fall from height due to absent or bypassed 100% tie-off fall arrest system.

screening_rules.name: Confined Space Entry with Omitted Gas Testing or Standby Attendant
screening_rules.description: Tank, vessel, or pit entry with hazardous/toxic atmosphere and missing atmospheric test or standby protection.
screening_rules.severity_details: Toxic gas poisoning (H2S), oxygen deficiency asphyxiation, or tank fire/explosion.

screening_rules.name: Live High Voltage Electrical Exposure without Isolation
screening_rules.description: Live electrical circuits or switchgear without Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and physical isolation.
screening_rules.severity_details: Electrocution or severe arc flash burns from unisolated high-voltage electrical equipment.

screening_rules.name: Hot Work in Flammable Zone without Gas Monitoring / Fire Watch
screening_rules.description: Welding, cutting, or grinding in gas-bearing operational zones without continuous gas clearance.
screening_rules.severity_details: Ignition of flammable hydrocarbon vapors leading to localized explosion or flash fire.

screening_rules.name: Low-Energy Housekeeping / Obstruction Event
screening_rules.description: Minor housekeeping, clutter, or trip hazard with low stored energy and no critical barrier degradation.
screening_rules.severity_details: Minor trip, slip, or scratch with low kinetic energy and no catastrophic consequence potential.
